subject: Workshop next week for remote computing

messages.author: 532359cb4f30370a
messages.subject: Workshop next week for remote computing
parts:
Hi D-RUGgies!

Next week Datalab is presenting a free workshop that will teach you how to use remote computing in your research. This means you’ll be able to use the University’s High Performance Computing resources like Hive or Farm or Franklin (https://hpc.ucdavis.edu/). If you work with the medical campus, these are the tools to use the Advanced Computing Environment (ACE, https://health.ucdavis.edu/data/hc2.html)

The workshop is all day Tuesday and Wednesday. Registration and more info at: https://events.library.ucdavis.edu/event/introduction-to-remote-computing-and-hpc-2026

I hope to see you there!
-Wes
